about-me.text: I have a strong passion for programming and a particular interest in modern web technologies. New challenges motivate me to continuously expand my knowledge and grow professionally. I am distinguished by my structured approach, strong planning skills, and solution-oriented mindset. Continuous learning is a key part of my professional development.

skills.text: I enjoy learning new technologies — just tell me what you need.

privacy.controllerText: The controller within the meaning of data protection laws, in particular the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), is:
privacy.rightsIntro: You can exercise the following rights at any time using the contact details provided, in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):
privacy.right1: Access to your data stored by us and information about its processing (Art. 15 GDPR),
privacy.right2: Correction of inaccurate personal data (Art. 16 GDPR),
privacy.right3: Deletion of your data stored by us (Art. 17 GDPR),
privacy.right4: Restriction of data processing if we are not yet allowed to delete your data due to legal obligations (Art. 18 GDPR),
privacy.right5: Objection to the processing of your data by us (Art. 21 GDPR), and
privacy.right6: Data portability if you have consented to data processing or entered into a contract with us (Art. 20 GDPR).
privacy.consentWithdrawal: If you have given us consent, you may withdraw it at any time with effect for the future.
privacy.complaint: You may lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority at any time, for example with the competent supervisory authority in the federal state of your residence or with the authority responsible for us as the controller.
privacy.authorityListBefore: A list of supervisory authorities for the non-public sector, including addresses, can be found at:
privacy.contactFormText: Our website provides a contact form that can be used for electronic contact. If a user makes use of this option, the data entered in the input form is transmitted to us and stored.
privacy.submitDataText: At the time the message is sent, the following data is also stored:
privacy.requestDate: Date and time of the request
privacy.emailContactText: Contact is possible via the email addresses provided. In this case, the personal data transmitted with the email is stored. This includes the date and time the email was sent, the email address, IP addresses and information about the servers involved in the email communication.
privacy.phoneContactText: You can contact us using the telephone numbers provided. In this case, we collect log data containing your telephone number and the duration of the call.
privacy.requestContentText: Regardless of the communication channel selected, we collect the content of your request. Your data is stored for the purpose of individual communication with you.
privacy.legalBasis1: The data is processed on the basis of a legitimate interest (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR).
privacy.legalBasis2: Our legitimate interest in processing your data is to enable straightforward contact.
privacy.legalBasis3: If you contact us to request an offer, the data is processed for the performance of pre-contractual measures (Art. 6 para. 1 lit. b GDPR).
privacy.recipientsText: Recipients of the data may include technical service providers who act as processors for the operation and maintenance of our website.
privacy.storage1: Data will be deleted no later than six months after the contact request has been processed, unless statutory retention obligations apply.
privacy.storage2: If a contractual relationship arises, we are subject to statutory retention periods. These are generally 6 or 10 years for reasons of proper accounting and tax requirements.
privacy.provisionText: Providing your personal data is voluntary. However, we can only process your request if you provide us with the required data and the reason for your request.
privacy.objectionText: Please read the information about your right to object under Art. 21 GDPR below.
privacy.objectionRightTitle: Information About Your Right to Object Under Art. 21 GDPR
privacy.individualObjection1: You have the right, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you that is based on Art. 6 para. 1 lit. f GDPR (data processing on the basis of a balancing of interests); this also applies to profiling based on this provision within the meaning of Art. 4 No. 4 GDPR.
privacy.individualObjection2: If you object, we will no longer process your personal data unless we can demonstrate compelling legitimate grounds for the processing that override your interests, rights and freedoms, or the processing serves the establishment, exercise or defense of legal claims.
privacy.changesText: We reserve the right to amend this privacy policy so that it always complies with current legal requirements or to implement changes to our services in the privacy policy, for example when introducing new services. The new privacy policy will then apply to your next visit.
privacy.questionsText: If you have any questions about data protection, please send us an email using the contact details of the controller above.
